description.short_caption: Facial skin with numerous pustules and papules.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows the face of a patient with numerous erythematous pustules and papules distributed across the nose, cheeks, and surrounding areas. The lesions appear raised and some have central purulent material. The image is de-identified with a black bar obscuring the eyes.
visible_findings: lesions distributed across the nose and cheeks

description.short_caption: Post-treatment appearance of the elbow with residual hyperpigmented macules.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows the elbow and surrounding skin. The skin appears dry with residual hyperpigmented macules scattered across the area. There is no evidence of active inflammation, ulceration, or exudate. The image suggests healing or resolution of a prior dermatologic or infectious condition.

description.short_caption: Papulonodular lesions on the upper extremity.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows the upper extremity, including the arm and elbow, with numerous scattered papulonodular lesions. The lesions are erythematous to violaceous, dome-shaped, and vary in size. The distribution appears diffuse, with no clear clustering. The skin surrounding the lesions shows no significant erythema or scaling.
visible_findings: diffuse distribution on the upper extremity
